summary: Iteration-3 review request verified. Backend: 13 new tests + 16 regression tests all pass (29/29). Frontend: Send Coins page transfer works end-to-end (balance decrements, INCOMING TRANSFER overlay renders with '[You received 50 coins from Player Two]' + sub-line), admin delete modal shows 'Are you sure?' with proper cancel/confirm flow and full cascade delete (returns 404 after). Broadcast page shows all 3 mode buttons (named/many/system). Player /send page sidebar contains no coin numbers. Player /players response strips coins/stats/vitals from other players — admin still gets full data.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~1058 lines — recommend splitting into routers (auth, players, coins, scenarios, notifications, items) for maintainability.
AdminPlayersPage recipient chip list can contain many duplicate-name players (test data + no name uniqueness); consider showing email suffix on chip to disambiguate.

SendCoinsPage does client-side balance check `amt > (user?.coins ?? 0)` but relies on stale user.coins from context — backend rejects correctly, so fine, but a refresh() before submit would prevent an occasional stale-toast.

NotificationPoller sub-line for coin_transfer uses 'You've received X coins from Y' while review copy example was 'You received X coins from Y' (matches bracketed primary line); minor cosmetic inconsistency between primary and sub-line — not a bug.

test_credentials.note: Test suite auto-registers TEST_-prefixed throwaway players per run.

seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_-prefixed players + one deleted UITEST Victim + scenarios created during test runs. Player2's balance decremented by 50 (transfer to UITEST Friend). Friend also received a 100-coin system-message credit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (16 tests) + /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py (13 tests, covers system-message mode, coin transfer, players privacy stripping, admin delete cascade). Run: `pytest backend/tests/ -v`. Key testids: send-recipient-{id}, send-amount, send-reason, send-submit, send-balance, send-party-{id}, broadcast-mode-{named|many|system}, delete-player-btn, delete-confirm-modal, delete-cancel, delete-confirm, notification-overlay, notification-dismiss. NotificationPoller renders `[ INCOMING TRANSFER ]` for kind=coin_transfer and `[ SYSTEM MESSAGE ]` for kind=constellation + system_message=true. UI overlay verification for coin_transfer confirmed live; system_message overlay verified via API + code inspection (same rendering pipeline).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration; all 4 new features (system message overlay copy, player-to-player coin transfer, players-list privacy, DM delete-with-confirm modal) plus regression are green.
